riddle: Laal gajar khata hai, lambe kaan hilata hai, phudak-phudak kar daud lagata hai... Batao kaun hoon main?
english: Eats red carrots, wiggles long ears, hops and runs fast... Who am I?
hint: Ye safed rang ka hota hai aur bohot tez bhagta hai!
celebration: Arre wah superstar! Sahi jawab! Khargosh 🐰! Aapko milta hai +1 Star ⭐!
wrong_cheer: Oho! Thoda socho... ye pyara safed janwar gajar khata hai! Try again!

riddle: Hara hoon par tota nahi, gol hoon par gend nahi, andar se laal hoon, meetha ras-dhaar hoon! Batao kya hoon main?
english: Green but not a parrot, round but not a ball, red inside, sweet and juicy! What am I?
hint: Garmiyon me bohot thanda-thanda khate hain isme kaale beej hote hain!
celebration: Super Champ! Bilkul sahi! Mitha-mitha Tarbooz (Watermelon) 🍉! +1 Star ⭐!
wrong_cheer: Arre nahi, ye bahar se hara aur andar se laal meetha hota hai!

riddle: Katori pe katora, beta baap se bhi gora! Batao kya?
english: A bowl on a bowl, the son is whiter than the father! What is it?
hint: Iska upar ka chilka brown hota hai aur andar safed paani aur giri hoti hai!
celebration: Wah Einstein! Sahi pakde hain! Nariyal (Coconut) 🥥! +1 Star ⭐!
wrong_cheer: Thoda socho... mandir me prasad me milta hai!

riddle: Ek janwar aisa jiske soond lambi aur kaan soop jaise, dholak jaisa pet aur khambhe jaise pair! Batao kaun?
english: An animal with a long trunk, ears like fans, belly like a drum and legs like pillars!
hint: Ye zameen ka sabse bada janwar hai aur kela khana pasand karta hai!
celebration: Hooray! Haathi Raja 🐘! Soond hilakar bole: Bahut badiya champ! +1 Star ⭐!
wrong_cheer: Arre dhyan se socho, lambi soond kiske paas hoti hai?

riddle: Teen haath hain par ungliyan nahi, chalti rehti hai par thakti nahi! Batao kya?
english: Has three hands but no fingers, keeps moving without getting tired! What is it?
hint: Ye deewar par latki hoti hai aur 'Tik-Tik' karti hai!
celebration: Tik-Tik-Tik! Sahi jawab! Ghadi (Clock) ⏰! Time batane me master! +1 Star ⭐!
wrong_cheer: Ye subah hume school ke liye time batati hai!

riddle: Subah aakar sabko jagata, shaam dhalte hi so jata, din bhar aasmaan me chamak kar roshni barsata! Batao kaun?
english: Wakes everyone in the morning, sleeps at sunset, shines in the sky all day!
hint: Ye peela aur aag ka gola jaisa hota hai!
celebration: Good Morning Super Champ! Bilkul sahi: Sooraj Chacha (Sun) ☀️! +1 Star ⭐!
wrong_cheer: Din me roshni kaun deta hai? Socho socho!

riddle: Pair zameen me gaad ke khada, dhoop sahe par chhaon deta, meethhe-meethhe phal khilata! Batao kya?
english: Stands with feet in the ground, bears the heat to give shade, offers sweet fruits!
hint: Isme hari-hari pattiya aur aam lagte hain!
celebration: Wah mere nature hero! Sahi jawab: Ped (Tree) 🌳! Clean air aur shade! +1 Star ⭐!
wrong_cheer: Is par chidiya ghosla banati hai, socho kaun hai!

riddle: Ek aisi cheez jiska pet gol, naak se dhuwan nikle, aur subah-subah gungunati hai?
english: Round belly, smoke comes from nose, whistles in the morning!
hint: Isme garam-garam chai ya daal banti hai!
celebration: Seetee baji! Sahi jawab: Ketli / Pressure Cooker 🫖! Brilliant mind! +1 Star ⭐!
wrong_cheer: Kitchen me seetee kaun bajata hai?

riddle: Barsaat aate hi kare 'Tarr-Tarr', paani aur zameen dono par koodta jaaye! Batao kaun?
english: Says croak-croak when it rains, jumps on water and land!
hint: Ye hara-hara hota hai aur bohot unchi chalang lagata hai!
celebration: Croak Croak! Shabaash! Mendhak (Frog) 🐸! Jump Champion! +1 Star ⭐!
wrong_cheer: Baarish me hara janwar kaun koodta hai?

riddle: Pankh nahi par udna sikhaye, zuban nahi par baatein bataye, gyaan ka khazana hai! Batao kya?
english: Has no wings but teaches how to fly, has no tongue but tells stories!
hint: Isko hum padhte hain aur isme pyari kahaniyan hoti hain!
celebration: Waah kitabi keeda! Bilkul sahi: Pyaari Kitaab (Book) 📖! +1 Star ⭐!
wrong_cheer: School bag me sabse zaroori cheez kya hoti hai jisme kahani hoti hai?
